messages:
Ashley M.: hey — i'm taking primary for the 00:00-08:00 window. quick context: saw the late-night paging spike for api-gen at ~23:45, partial degradation (timeouts ~5-10%). i left the immediate mitigation in place (route traffic to rtx-2, scaled isolates). leaving Samir as secondary.

Samir: ack. got it. i'll keep an eye on the gen queue and call if anything flares. what's the main metrics to watch?

Ashley M.: top things: 1) /v1/generate 5xx% (watch 5m avg), 2) avg token latency > 450ms, 3) qlen on inference-worker (if > 60 start draining), and 4) kv-cache evictions spike.

Samir: noted. do we have a temporary runbook snippet for the routing fallback?

Miguel L.: i pushed a short runbook note to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2024-11-api-gen-23 — also filed ticket INC-4821 to track root cause and config drift on autoscaler.

Ashley M.: thanks. quick commands in case you need them:
```
# drain a worker
redwoodctl node drain rtx-2a
# fallback to cheaper variant
redwoodctl route set --model gpt-large-v2 -> gpt-medium-v1 --weight 0.4
```

Samir: nice. i also left a temporary alert mute for the noisy alerting group (15m) to reduce noise while we stabilize.

incident-bot: ALERT: api-gen-5xx-rate high (rule: api:gen:5xx) — first fired 2024-11-17T23:45:12Z. Current: 7.8% 5m.

Jen: is customer impact confirmed? any major apps affected?

Ashley M.: short answer: degraded performance for a subset of high-throughput customers (primarily batch generation). we did not see large-scale data loss. support ticket bundle prepared: ST-3245, ST-3246. cs has been notified with the mitigation note.

Kai: logging note — enable verbose token-logging only on canary to avoid logging PII. put this in the incident doc before we flip flags.

Samir: action items i'm tracking: 1) follow-up RFC for autoscaler thresholds (assigned MIGUEL), 2) add qlen alert with runbook link (assigned SAMIR), 3) schedule retro (Ashley to own), 4) track INC-4821.

Miguel L.: RFC PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/rfcs/pull/77 — will add proposal to cap burst scaling and adjust cooldowns.

Ashley M.: for the handoff: i'm online for the first 30m in case anything reappears, then will be offline but reachable by DM. samir is primary watch after that.

Samir: will do. i'll post any state changes here. good handoff, ash. :thumbsup:

Ashley M.: thanks everyone. post-handoff follow-up: i'll create the retro invite for tomorrow 10:00 and attach the incident timeline and ticket list.

Jen: noted — i'll sync with cs on customer comms and add the appropriate postmortem template items.

Kai: small ops note: consider adding a KV cache TTL audit in next week's backlog (todo in project board).

Ashley M.: logged: ACTIONS = [INC-4821, RFC-77 PR, ST-3245/6 customer notes, retro invite]. closing handoff.

Samir: closing ack.
